sources.title: Understanding BLIP : A Huggingface Model - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: BLIP (Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training) is a multimodal AI model that combines computer vision and natural language processing to understand both images and text together. It is trained on large-scale image-text pairs, enabling strong performance in vision-language tasks.

sources.title: Base Models | salesforce/BLIP | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Base Models Relevant source files This page documents the foundational model architectures in the BLIP system: BLIP_Base and BLIP_Decoder. These models serve as the core building blocks for various vision-language tasks including image captioning, visual question answering, and image-text retrieval.
